cohort: Exp493 frozen 125 datasets, one dataset per source family
grid_status: sensitivity grid for descriptive comparison, not a selected operational false-positive budget

definitions.tpr: Maximum empirical TPR among deterministic thresholds with empirical FPR <= grid value; ties remain together; no interpolation. This uses TEST labels to trace the retrospective ROC and is not a calibrated operating threshold.
definitions.macro: Equal weight for each of 125 families.
definitions.zf: Anomalies with score strictly greater than maximum normal TEST score.
definitions.evaluation_unit: Whole time-series instance, not time point or alarm event.

backend_assessment.numba: Assessed: no new NumPy performance-critical scorer; this is a short read-only cache/ranking aggregation. Retain official compiled library routines; no JIT replacement or algorithm change.
backend_assessment.gpu: No score-source run or tensor training; no GPU path introduced.

exclusions: Exp491 historical 1117 rows / 128 families is not pooled into the current 125-family cohort.
No retraining, route re-selection, threshold calibration, statistical significance test, or model promotion.
